pages.title: Proton Decay
pages.text: $(thing)Proton Decay$()$(br2)Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.

$(thing)Insight$(): 180$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Grand Unification.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Superpartner Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): In a theory that unifies the forces, a heavy boson of mass M_X can turn a quark into a lepton. A proton of mass m_p then decays by exchanging it; the rate is the square of the unified coupling α_G, times m_p⁵ by dimensional analysis, divided by M_X⁴, times a hadronic factor A. Write the proton lifetime (units ħ = c = 1).
